definition.description: First calendar date of the reported survey window.

definition.description: Last calendar date of the reported survey window.
definition.notes: AI Description — added by FAIRmorph. AI-assisted FAIRmorph PoC interpretation; not written, reviewed, approved or endorsed by CS-PHOC authors, owners or maintainers. Literal CSV header differs from census_end_date in the source README.

definition.description: Number of calendar dates included in the reported survey window, counting both the start and end dates.
definition.notes: AI Description — added by FAIRmorph. AI-assisted FAIRmorph PoC interpretation; not written, reviewed, approved or endorsed by CS-PHOC authors, owners or maintainers. Source-derived: all 322 values equal end minus start plus one day. The README documents a conflicting shorthand; no assertion about field-hours or actual effort.

definition.description: Boolean indicator stating whether Punta San Telmo was surveyed during this source survey window.
definition.notes: AI Description — added by FAIRmorph. AI-assisted FAIRmorph PoC interpretation; not written, reviewed, approved or endorsed by CS-PHOC authors, owners or maintainers. FALSE does not imply species absence.
